steps.title: What this does
steps.confirm: I understand that agents I allow can fully control the computers I add.
steps.body:
This lets your agents work on other computers, over your private Tailscale network. There are three levels:

- **Look:** list the computers, see facts about them, and take screenshots.
- **Act:** run commands as administrator.
- **Drive:** use the mouse and keyboard.

The computer's own remote-control program does not ask the person at the PC before it runs a command. So by default My Maestro asks **you, on your phone,** before an agent's first Act or Drive in each session. You can turn that question off for a single agent, but that is riskier. Every agent starts at Look.

We strongly recommend a **dedicated PC with nothing personal on it.** An agent you allow to Act or Drive can do anything on that computer.

steps.title: Install
steps.body: Installs the remote-control server this connector runs (MeshCentral). It is about 230 MB in all with the agent programs it hands to the computers, and is only downloaded once. Nothing is installed on any other computer in this step.

steps.title: Your settings
steps.body: Find this computer's name and its 100.x address in the Tailscale app on this computer, or run `tailscale status` in a terminal. The name looks like hub.example.ts.net and the address like 100.64.0.10. The ports can stay as they are.

steps.title: Start the server
steps.body: Starts the server and checks that it is running. This can take a minute the first time.

steps.title: Prepare the PC
steps.body:
On the PC you want to add:

1. Use **Windows 11** with a **local account**, not a Microsoft account.
2. Set it to **sign in automatically** and to **never lock or sleep.** Screenshots and mouse control need someone signed in.
3. Install **Tailscale** and sign in to the same tailnet as this computer.
4. Keep personal files and accounts off it.

steps.title: Get the installer
steps.body: Makes a link that works once, for 15 minutes. Open it in a browser on the PC. It downloads the helper program.

steps.title: Check the PC is connected
steps.body: After you run the helper on the PC, check that it shows up here. It can take a minute.

steps.title: Session length
steps.body: When you say yes to an agent's Act or Drive on your phone, the yes lasts for this many minutes. Then the agent has to ask again. You choose what each agent may do (Look, Act or Drive) in the next step.

steps.title: Who can use it at all
steps.body:
Choose which agents may use remote computers, and what each may do. The lead agent is always allowed.

- **Look:** pictures and facts only.
- **Act:** also runs commands.
- **Drive:** also uses the mouse and keyboard.

Every agent starts at Look. For Act and Drive, **Ask me before each session** is ticked: you say yes on your phone once per session. Turn it off only for an agent you fully trust.
